title: General finite-time expected-distance RPCD complexity
assumptions: Every epoch draws a fresh independent uniform permutation
Accuracy is relative expected A-distance and cost counts coordinate updates
implication_sources: C001 plus a dimension-uniform finite-time bridge
open_objections: The unrestricted n>=7 statement remains open.
A fixed one-epoch A-energy certificate is sufficient but has not been shown necessary.
The original asymptotic covariance conjecture alone currently carries a dimension-dependent finite-time prefactor.
